libraries.notes: First tool library in Kentucky. 2,436+ items. 7-day lending cycle. 10 hand tools and 2 power tools per checkout.

libraries.address: 321 W. Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Covington, KY 41011
libraries.notes: Partnership between Kenton County Public Library and Center for Great Neighborhoods. Free with library card. Up to 3 items, 7-day loan. Open Mon & Wed 4-7pm, Fri 1-6pm.

metadata.notes: Kentucky has three major tool/things lending programs. Louisville Tool Library has 2,436+ items across 21 categories. Lexington Tool Library has 319+ items with pay-what-you-can membership. Kenton County Empower Tools is a free public library program with 51+ tools. Item lists for Louisville and Lexington are representative samples from their online catalogs; full inventories are much larger.
